notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hi,

The game is finally getting released for early access. Initially, the game was made in UE 5.0, then updated to 5.1, and now is in 5.2.

The core gameplay loop is done with the ability to unlock hats and skins for the blocks.

Right now there are only two hats available. I'll add hats and block skins once I find out how the game feels.

I want to add a settings page since the game can be taxing on the system.

Just waiting on steam pricing review and then it should be released.
